item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces zinc borohydride as a multifunctional additive in a ternary acetonitrile-triethyl phosphate-tetrahydrofuran electrolyte, using synergistic anion-solvent engineering. The BH4− anions regulate Zn2+ solvation and promote uniform deposition, suppressing dendrites. This enables 400 h symmetric-cell cycling and 82.2% capacity retention after 2000 cycles, offering a viable strategy for high-safety, high-performance non-aqueous zinc-ion batteries.

item.title: Proximity‐Engineered Dual‐Atomic Cobalt Sites Enable Adaptive Spin Catalysis for Simultaneous Oxygen and Peroxide Reduction
item.description:
مهندسی مجاورت دو اتم کبالت در COF یک‌بعدی با اسپین تطبیقی، واکنش کاهش اکسیژن و پراکسید را همزمان بهبود می‌بخشد و عملکرد باتری روی-هوا را افزایش می‌دهد.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Proximity engineering of dual-atomic Co sites in a covalent organic framework tunes Co–Co separation, creating coexisting high-spin and low-spin configurations. These complementary spins resolve oxygen-intermediate adsorption conflicts, enabling adaptive spin catalysis. The catalyst achieves a 0.96 V half-wave potential, outperforming Pt/C, and boosts zinc–air and peroxide-assisted aluminum–air batteries, establishing spin-state complementarity as a design principle for atomic catalysts.
🏷 dual-atomic cobalt · spin catalysis · oxygen reduction · covalent organic framework · zinc-air battery

item.title: Breaking the Additive Paradox in Aqueous Aluminum‐Ion Batteries via Weak‐Coordination Asymmetric Electrolyte Chemistry
item.description:
الکترولیت نامتقارن با کوئوردیناسیون ضعیف، پارادوکس افزودنی را در باتری‌های آبی آلومینیوم-یون می‌شکند و پایداری چرخه را بهبود می‌دهد.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a weak-coordination asymmetric electrolyte (Al(OTF)₃/DMSO/FEC) that breaks the additive paradox in aqueous aluminum-ion batteries. DMSO disrupts Al³⁺ solvation while FEC compensates dielectric and interfacial failures, enabling 2000 h Al plating/stripping and 90.8% capacity retention over 2000 cycles. It reframes additive design as sequential identification and compensation of coupled failure mechanisms.

item.title: Self-Healing Armor Enables Electrode Integrity and Interfacial Stability for Durable Silicon Anodes
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an in situ UV-copolymerized self-healing fluorinated acrylate coating that repairs microcracks within one minute via reversible dipole-dipole interactions while acting as a fluorine reservoir to build a stable LiF-rich SEI. This dual mechanism enables durable silicon anodes, demonstrated in a 1.5 Ah pouch cell with 71.9% retention after 300 cycles and improved thermal safety.
